description: Quark - high-performance Minecraft: Bedrock server software derived from PocketMine-MP and Axolotl. PM5 / PHP 8.4 only. Uses the Bedrock-Phanatics PHP 8.4 runtime and builds the latest Quark stable branch.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl ca-certificates tar unzip zip file

cd /mnt/server

ARCH="$(uname -m)"
if [[ "$ARCH" != "x86_64" ]]; then
    echo "Quark's Bedrock-Phanatics PHP 8.4 PM5 runtime currently supports Linux x86_64 for this egg."
    echo "Detected architecture: $ARCH"
    exit 1
fi

PHP_URL="https://github.com/Bedrock-Phanatics/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/pm5-php-8.4-latest/PHP-8.4-Linux-x86_64-PM5.tar.gz"

echo "Downloading Bedrock-Phanatics PHP 8.4 runtime for PM5..."
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --progress-bar "$PHP_URL" -o /tmp/quark-php.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/quark-php.tar.gz
rm -f /tmp/quark-php.tar.gz

if [[ ! -x "./bin/php7/bin/php" ]]; then
    echo "PHP runtime extraction failed: ./bin/php7/bin/php was not found."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Configuring PHP extension directory..."
EXTENSION_DIR="$(find bin -type d -name '*debug-zts*' -print -quit)"
if [[ -z "$EXTENSION_DIR" ]]; then
    echo "Unable to locate the PHP extension directory."
    exit 1
fi

PHP_INI="./bin/php7/bin/php.ini"
if grep -q '^extension_dir' "$PHP_INI"; then
    sed -i "s{^extension_dir=.*{extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"{" "$PHP_INI"
else
    echo "extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"" >> "$PHP_INI"
fi

echo "Installing Composer..."
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --silent --show-error \
    https://getcomposer.org/installer -o /tmp/composer-setup.php
./bin/php7/bin/php /tmp/composer-setup.php \
    --install-dir=/mnt/server \
    --filename=composer.phar \
    --quiet
rm -f /tmp/composer-setup.php

echo "Cloning Quark stable..."
rm -rf /mnt/server/.quark-build
git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/Bedrock-Phanatics/Quark.git /mnt/server/.quark-build

echo "Building Quark..."
cd /mnt/server/.quark-build
/mnt/server/bin/php7/bin/php /mnt/server/composer.phar run-script make-server --no-interaction

if [[ ! -f "PocketMine-MP.phar" ]]; then
    echo "Quark build failed: PocketMine-MP.phar was not produced."
    exit 1
fi

mv -f PocketMine-MP.phar /mnt/server/PocketMine-MP.phar

cd /mnt/server
rm -rf /mnt/server/.quark-build
rm -f /mnt/server/composer.phar

if [[ ! -f server.properties ]]; then
    echo "Downloading default server.properties..."
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
        --silent --show-error \
        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/game_eggs/minecraft/bedrock/pocketmine_mp/server.properties \
        -o server.properties
fi

touch banned-ips.txt banned-players.txt ops.txt white-list.txt server.log
mkdir -p players worlds plugins resource_packs

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "|                                      |"
echo "|       Quark Installation Done        |"
echo "|        PM5 / PHP 8.4 / x86_64        |"
echo "|                                      |"
echo "----------------------------------------"
